objective: Find previously registered employment channels that can be reused without a new interview, identity flow, installation, or fee, while keeping the current weekly user operation to one event source.

measurements.pipeline_reason: No current job inventory, accepted assignment, or current gross was read back from either dormant source.

sources.evidence: Personalized registered-staff job messages through 2025-11-29 direct the user to an existing web job-selection portal; no later registration-removal, rejection, expiry, or account-stop email was found.
sources.user_operation_policy: Use only as the single checked event source when it is already authenticated and the higher-ranked formally hired app is unavailable; do not re-register or recover credentials in this weekly session.
sources.success_condition: Current safe, non-overlapping jobs are visible and up to two personally accepted jobs display combined gross of at least JPY 20,800.
sources.withdrawal_condition: Login recovery, re-registration, identity work, a fee, unsafe travel/workload, or no current eligible inventory is required.

sources.evidence: Personalized job invitations through 2025-10-08 state that work could be reserved by email, an existing SMS job finder, or phone; no later registration-removal, rejection, expiry, or account-stop email was found. The official site still presents registered event work and registration routes as of this measurement.
sources.user_operation_policy: Do not add this source to the current weekly session. Retain it as a second-line reactivation option only after a fresh current-status read-back can be obtained without increasing the present action bundle.
sources.success_condition: A current personalized invitation or authenticated inventory confirms continued usability and a safe job.
sources.withdrawal_condition: A new registration/interview is required or no current personalized work signal appears by the option kill date.

rejected_source.reason: Only a 2026-06 registration-selection reservation and onboarding instructions were found; no completion or hire evidence was found. It is not treated as registered, contracted, or pipeline.

official_readback.finding: The official site currently exposes registered event-work inquiry and registration information.
The official company site remains active and describes ongoing event staffing operations; private current inventory remains behind the existing staff portal.

decision.reason: A substitution ladder widens the chance of finding current inventory without multiplying user logins or adding registration work.
decision.reason_not_quantified: Dormant registration evidence is useful capacity but cannot be counted as money until current inventory and acceptance are read back.

privacy: No person name, email address, phone number, account identifier, message identifier, secret, or job-site address is stored.
